data.body: Resolved by PR #341 (merge commit 400a488290): manual API Gateway HTTP API provisioned in front of the Lambda (documented as INSTALL.md 'Telemetry Infrastructure' step 5). API Gateway invokes the Lambda via lambda:InvokeFunction with the apigateway.amazonaws.com service principal — a different IAM action from lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl, so the SCP o-t5fn7az6cp deny does not apply. Anonymous client POSTs to the API Gateway endpoint reach S3 with no AWS credentials. Live evidence: docs/findings/d2f9-apigateway-bypass-20260524T210910Z.md (HTTP 202 + S3 write side-by-side against the still-403'd Function URL). Ticket remains in archived state; this comment is for audit trail.
